evals.prompt: Turn my validated treatment-response chart into a mechanism-led graphical abstract with GPT Image 2.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses the chart to define the evidence hierarchy, generates a conceptual illustration, identifies any AI-redrawn chart content, and does not claim that generated pixels are unchanged quantitative evidence.

assertions.name: functional_first
assertions.description: Conceptual generation and visual QA complete without forcing optional publication controls.

assertions.name: evidence_boundary
assertions.description: GPT Image output is described as illustration rather than new measurement.

evals.prompt: Generate the final research schematic now, but the relay URL and API key are blank.
evals.expected_output: Preflight reports the exact missing configuration and no network call or substitute provider is used.

assertions.name: no_fallback
assertions.description: No default URL, provider, mock, or retry path is used.

evals.prompt: Verify and deliver a composite whose chart region was edited after provenance generation, without strict mode.
evals.expected_output: Verification reports the output or pixel mismatch clearly but does not block delivery unless strict mode was explicitly requested.

assertions.name: tamper_detected
assertions.description: A changed output or trusted chart region is detected.

assertions.name: advisory_default
assertions.description: The finding is advisory by default.

evals.prompt: Polish a four-panel scientific figure from four high-resolution panel references.
evals.expected_output: Preflight reports the reference load and the agent creates one deterministic reference sheet before an explicit edit request instead of repeating an expensive multipart request.

assertions.name: reference_profile
assertions.description: Reference count, dimensions, pixels, and bytes are visible.

assertions.name: deterministic_sheet
assertions.description: The source panels are assembled deterministically into one API reference.

evals.prompt: Make this first-derivative spectral comparison figure cleaner while preserving all peaks and labels.
evals.expected_output: The generated edit is classified as a layout blueprint, audited against preprocessing and normalization state, and not delivered as quantitative evidence until rebuilt or composited from source panels.

assertions.name: state_lock
assertions.description: Derivative state, normalization scope, axis, and labels are audited.

assertions.name: no_ai_data_claim
assertions.description: AI-redrawn curves are not treated as measured evidence.
